**Networking Event: Meta-Research and Reproducibility**
</br>
Join us for an online networking session on October 29th, 2025, from 12:00–13:00 CET, facilitated by MERRI contributor Alex Bannach-Brown. This event offers an informal space to connect with others interested in meta-research, open science, and reproducibility. Whether you’re a seasoned researcher, early-career scholar, or simply curious about improving research practices, this is a chance to share ideas, exchange experiences, and expand your network.

Stay tuned, more details are coming soon!
